hero.headline: I'm Blessing, and I build mobile and web apps.
hero.subheadline: Mostly React Native and Flutter, plus React, Next.js and the Node.js APIs behind them. Right now I build Rolla Pay, a cross-border payments app, and the customer and vendor apps at Local Eats Africa.

about.heading: About
paragraphs: I started building software for clients in 2023, mostly startups and founders who needed an app or a website and someone to see it through to launch. In 2025 I joined Varsigram, where I led the frontend and mobile team until June 2026, and in February 2026 I joined Local Eats Africa, where I still build the customer and vendor apps. In August 2026 I joined Rolla Pay, a fintech company building a cross-border payments platform, and shipped its app to Google Play and the App Store.
At Local Eats, more than 150 vendors take orders through the apps I work on. A lot of my time there goes into keeping those apps fast and dependable on slow networks and cheaper Android phones.

My degree is in automobile technology, from the University of Benin. From December 2025 to July 2026 I taught mobile development at CoderTech, and I've been studying security on the side. I finished Cisco's junior cybersecurity analyst path in 2026 and I'm working toward CompTIA Security+.
focusAreas: Mobile apps in React Native and Flutter
Web apps in React and Next.js

points: Building the Rolla Pay app in React Native, Expo and TypeScript for a cross-border payments platform; shipped it to Google Play and the App Store.
Built the money flows end to end: multi-currency wallets, deposits, sending money (including CAD by Interac e-Transfer), currency swaps and transaction history.

Built the security layer: Google and Apple sign-in, two-factor authentication (email and authenticator app), biometric unlock, secure token storage, and KYC identity verification with document scans and liveness checks.
Own releases on React Native's New Architecture: push notifications, over-the-air updates and in-app update prompts.
Built the customer app (LEA) and the vendor app (LEVA) for a food delivery platform with 150+ vendors, both live on Google Play: ordering, sign-in, Paystack payments and live order tracking.
Brought API latency down by 40% with caching and frontend performance work.
Made product changes based on analytics that raised retention by 20%.
Tuned the apps for slow networks and low-end Android phones, and helped keep production at 99.9% uptime.
Set up Sentry crash reporting, over-the-air updates and in-app update prompts so fixes reach users without waiting on store review.
Taught React Native, Flutter and frontend architecture through project-based courses on auth, APIs, state management and deployment.
Got students using GitHub the way working teams do: branches, pull requests and code review.
Led the frontend and mobile team across several products, working with product, design and backend to get features shipped.
Set up the app architecture and the shared components the React and React Native apps were built on.
Built Varsigram's real-time chat microservice in Node.js, TypeScript, Socket.IO and Prisma, with JWT auth and a GitHub Actions pipeline that deploys to staging and production.
Reviewed code, wrote the team's engineering standards, and mentored developers on TypeScript, architecture and debugging.
Build apps and websites for startups and founders, from planning through launch.
React Native and Flutter apps for e-commerce and other customer-facing products, and Sanity-backed websites clients can update themselves.
Integrate auth, payments, analytics and third-party APIs.

items.name: Rolla Pay
items.description: A cross-border payments app: hold money in wallets, deposit, send money abroad, swap currencies and follow every transaction. Live on Google Play and the App Store.

Google and Apple sign-in, 2FA, biometric unlock and KYC identity checks

items.name: AI food ordering assistant

Checkout and payment inside the chat

items.name: INVENTRA

highlights: Tools merchants use to run their store

items.name: Varsigram

items.name: LEVA
items.description: The app restaurants and food vendors on Local Eats use to run their store: incoming orders, menus, prices, opening hours and sales.

Dashboards for sales and store activity

items.name: Local Eats Africa
